records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities relate to advance consideration received from customers or advance billings for which revenue has not been recognized and are reduced when the associated revenue from the contract is recognized.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue recognized during the six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2024 that was included in contract liabilities at the beginning of the period amounted to $116,466 and $137,828, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, the Company has classified the results of operations as discontinued operations in the condensed consolidated statements of earnings and the condensed consolidated statements of cash flows for the six months ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Depreciation expense totaled $43,157 and $38,554 for the three months ended June 30, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2024, depreciation expense totaled $81,826 and $76,380, respectively.
